subject: Post-demo: procurement sprint & billing path confirmation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tanya Shah <tanya@zenly.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@zenly.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement sprint & billing path confirmation

Hi Tanya — great to meet you and the team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to align procurement with pricing options so we can hit your Q4 timeline:

Summary of what we covered:
- Use case: real-time assistant for support agents (latency-sensitive, peaks during EOW)
- Candidate hosting: Hosted (fastest to production), Dedicated (predictable throughput + committed discounts), Private (customer VPC, for regulated data)
- Billing preferences discussed: PO with monthly invoicing (preferred), corporate card for POC, marketplace purchase (possible for self-serve)

What we need from Zenly to speed procurement:
- Procurement signal: will you require a formal PO for the annual contract or is card ok for initial POC?
- Marketplace interest: do you need marketplace listing (AWS/GCP) for internal purchasing rules?
- Security artifacts: SOC2, data retention commitments, and auditable logs (we've attached a SOC2 stub and a short procurement checklist)

Actions / owners:
- Zenly: confirm PO vs card for the POC and longer-term engagement (Tanya) — by EOD Wed 10/27
- Redwood: provide cost profile for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private including commit tiers and lead time (Marcus) — by Thu 10/28
- Redwood: share security pack & sample SOW language (Neha) — done (attached)

Attachments: Zenly_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (procurement questions & timeline), Hosted_vs_Dedicated_Pricing_Options.xlsx

If PO is required we will draft a simple procurement exhibit that maps commit levels to unit pricing and billing cadence so procurement can route it to finance. If marketplace is needed, we can flag the deal to our partnership team but that path typically adds 2–3 weeks to onboarding.

Would love a quick confirm on the PO vs card callout so Marcus can size the commit scenarios.

Thanks!

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Tanya Shah <tanya@zenly.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@zenly.ai>, Ben Lopez <ben.lopez@zenly.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 Oct 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement sprint & billing path confirmation

Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement POV:

- For POC (30 days) we can use corporate card; for production we will require a PO and 30-day net terms.
- Marketplace: desirable for internal approvals but not mandatory — if marketplace listing adds time, we can proceed without it for initial contract.
- Security: please send SOC2, data retention policy, and a sample invoice. Also route any export controls or data residency notes — we operate partly from EU later this year.

Can Marcus provide two billing scenarios: (A) Hosted on-demand with estimated monthly spend and (B) Dedicated 1-year commit with unit price and expected cost savings at 6/12/24 month horizons? That will help procurement choose the path.

Target: finalize procurement path and get PO in place by Nov 10 to align with our internal quarter close.

Thanks — Tanya
Tanya Shah
Head of Operations, Zenly.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tanya Shah <tanya@zenly.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement sprint & billing path confirmation

Hi Tanya — I pulled together the two scenarios and attached a short spreadsheet (Hosted_vs_Dedicated_Pricing_Options.xlsx). High-level notes:

Scenario A — Hosted (on-demand)
- No upfront commit, pay-as-you-go per token/embedding.
- Best for POC and variable traffic; expected monthly spend estimate: $8k–$12k based on the usage profile you shared.
- Marketplace: if purchased via marketplace, invoicing will follow marketplace cadence (may impact net terms).

Scenario B — Dedicated (1-year commit)
- Dedicated GPU pool with predictable throughput and a 25% discount at a mid-level commit.
- Commit bands included in the spreadsheet; example: 3 month ramp then steady-state results in ~18% unit-cost reduction vs hosted for steady workloads.
- Requires a standard commitment exhibit and a PO to lock pricing. Lead time for provisioning is ~2–3 weeks after signing.

Other operational clarifications:
- Private (VPC) is available; pricing is custom and typically includes an additional platform fee. We'll provide an indicative quote if you want to explore that route.
- We can accommodate 30-day net terms via PO for production contracts — we'll add that language to the procurement exhibit.

Next steps I propose:
1) Priyom: share the spreadsheet and a short procurement exhibit draft with PO/net terms language (today).
2) Tanya/Zenly: confirm whether you want an indicative Private quote or to start with Hosted vs Dedicated options (reply by Tue 11/2).
3) If PO path chosen, procurement will route for PO approvals and we will prepare the final exhibit for signature.

Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up with procurement + finance if helpful.

Best,
Marcus

From: Ben Lopez <ben.lopez@zenly.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement sprint & billing path confirmation

Priyom / Marcus — quick confirm from legal & procurement ops: PO with 30-day net is standard and fine. We will evaluate the Dedicated commit if the spreadsheet shows >15% savings at our expected steady-state. Marketplace is a nice-to-have but not a blocker for contracting. Please include sample SOW language for data handling and termination assistance.

Ben Lopez
General Counsel, Zenly.ai
procurement@zenly.ai
